name: hfro
description: Two read-only reviewers for Claude Code: a plan-advisor that checks larger or riskier plans before work starts, and an advisor that must approve every non-trivial result before it reaches the user (enforced by hooks). Falls back to another model when Fable hits its limit.

fallback_model.title: Fallback model for the reviewers
fallback_model.description: Model the advisor and plan-advisor use when Fable is at its usage or rate limit or unavailable: opus, sonnet, haiku, or off (no fallback).

fallback_effort.title: Fallback effort
fallback_effort.description: Effort level for the fallback model: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.
